page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.4xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server belonging to the Enhanced family. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance allocates 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores using simultaneous multithreading (2 threads per core). It features 128 GB of RAM, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 8 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Cryptographic and vector workloads benefit from hardware-level AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI instructions. The instance offers a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, includes no bundled local storage, and does not provide GPU acceleration.

Performance benchmarks across compute and memory operations place the ecs.r7t.4xlarge within expected mid-tier ranges. Single-core and multi-core evaluations show solid throughput, scoring 1607.0 in Geekbench single-core and 9709.0 in multi-core, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 21137.68 and stress-ng multi-core throughput of 15552.92. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 98.25 GB/sec on large 256 MB blocks, with cached block reads measuring 850.62 GB/sec. The instance delivers 15.92 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations. In AI inference evaluations, the server achieves an above-average text generation rate of 265.61 tokens per second on small 135M parameter models, though prompt processing and larger model execution fall into median performance bands.

From an infrastructure perspective, the ecs.r7t.4xlarge balances high memory density with standard compute capacity. Because no local storage is bundled, system configurations must rely entirely on remote network storage volumes for persistence, which concentrates operational I/O over network channels alongside standard baseline traffic. The 8 GB RAM per vCPU allocation creates favorable efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require proportional scaling of raw processing cores. The hardware setup is directly tailored for in-memory caches, distributed key-value stores like Redis, operational relational databases, data preprocessing jobs, and memory-heavy application backends.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Configured with 8 physical cores and 16 dedicated vCPUs, it pairs 128 GB of system memory with 48 MB of L3 cache, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. The instance includes hardware support for AVX-512 and cryptographic instructions such as AES and SHA-NI, while provisioning no local storage and requiring attached cloud storage volumes. Network performance provides a 10 Gbps baseline. Benchmark evaluations locate the instance within the mid-tier for general CPU and memory throughput, alongside a Redis throughput of 15.92 million operations per second and strong text generation speed of 265.61 tokens per second on lightweight language models. This profile makes ecs.r7t.4xlarge well matched for in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, enterprise backend services, and intermediate memory-intensive analytical processing.
